method: Shared coordinate-only spatial MST followed by scanner-specific top-cosine residual edge selection.
chance_adjustment: Residual edge agreement adjusted against independent uniform selection from each residual candidate pool.
limitations: Shared backbone artificially raises full-edge stability
Global and spatial residual pools differ in size
Uniform random overlap is not a geometry-matched null model
Ten regions are not verified independent specimens
Connectivity alone does not establish representation robustness
